reason: SCRIPTS RESET — Julian, 2026-07-26: "i want you to take all episodes out so we start on zero to run fresh", and the Studio still showed Episode 1 after I had zeroed the registry twice.
theActualMechanism: cb-studio/serve.py:192 DERIVES the episode list — it globs SCRIPTS/Ep*.txt on every page load, rebuilds episodes.json from whatever script files exist, and writes it back. The registry is a CACHE, not the source. Zeroing it was pointless: the page load at 15:07 regenerated it from Ep1_..._Final_v3.txt within milliseconds. THE SCRIPT FILE IS THE EPISODE. To reach zero, the script has to move.
restoreToRunAgain: Copy any file from this folder back into shows/crystal-bears/episodes/scripts/ (named Ep<N>_*.txt) and the Studio re-registers the episode on the next page load. Ep<N>.title carries the exact display title.
